title: Operate Cancellation, Return, and Refund in Axis
readerIntent: Operate and recover order lifecycle cases safely in Axis.
owner: Business operations use Axis; backend capabilities authorize and execute every action
summary: Axis presents lifecycle, money, inventory, approval, provider and recovery evidence without becoming a second authority.

sections.heading: Find and understand a case
items: Open only a workspace published by authenticated bootstrap; missing permissions remove the workspace and its actions.
Confirm tenant, enterprise, order, customer scope, request type, version, reason, requested items and current lifecycle state.
Use owner evidence to understand fulfillment, inventory, product, payment, RMA, provider and notification progress. Raw provider payloads and secrets are never displayed.

sections.heading: Cancellation operations
items: Check whether the request is full or partial and whether the policy window is still open.
Review shipment, allocation and settlement facts before approval. The displayed amount is evidence, not an editable finance field.
When an external outcome is uncertain, use the permitted reconciliation action; never submit the same money or shipment operation manually.

sections.heading: Return operations
items: Track every RMA independently through authorization, receipt, inspection and disposition.
Verify serial numbers and quantities against immutable authorization. Partial receipt keeps remaining RMA work visible.
Inventory movement follows disposition; Order publishes refund eligibility only after Fulfillment outcomes are terminal.

sections.heading: Refund and approval
items: Review the exact amount, currency, tax, shipping, discount, item and original payment allocation evidence.
Maker and checker must be independent where policy requires it. Rejection and information requests preserve their decision evidence.
Provider timeout moves the case to reconciliation required. Completion requires every provider transaction to match the approved original-rail allocation.

sections.heading: Administration and incident response
items: Create draft policy or reason changes, obtain approval and publish through backend actions; published history is immutable.
Use exception ownership to route payment, fulfillment, inventory, risk or Order findings to the correct team.
Record correlation code, actor, reason and evidence for retry, reconciliation, escalation and manual resolution. Escalate suspected data leakage or cross-tenant access immediately.
